name: Stop & Shop Frozen DC Plainville CT

fieldNotes.site: Positively identified as the Americold automated frozen warehouse at 24 Northwest Drive, Plainville CT (Ahold Delhaize / ADUSA Supply Chain, serving Stop & Shop and Hannaford). Street View shows the AMERICOLD logo and a '24' address marker on the tall building. ~130 ft tall, 230K+ sq ft, fully automated case-pick frozen DC; the tall ASRS high-bay casts the large shadow seen in satellite.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole property is enclosed by continuous chain-link perimeter fence confirmed in Street View along the entire Northwest Drive frontage (employee-parking side, drop-yard side, and east elevation). Main truck/visitor entrance is a divided in/out road around a landscaped median at the SE/east end of the property where the access drive meets Northwest Drive (~41.6929,-72.8567). Controlled, fenced entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Americold staffs a dedicated 'Gate Guard' role at this site (job posting: opens gates for truckers, checks credentials / approved roster before admitting through gates). The Street View car never enters the private divided drive, so the booth structure is not directly resolved in imagery; booth is inside the entrance throat. Guarded entry called true on operational + geometric evidence; flagged uncertain because the booth itself is not pixel-confirmed.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed gate guard is present (not a kiosk/app-only check-in).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between the gate and the dock face on the west/drop-yard side gives ample inside-the-fence holding room before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep approach: the divided access drive plus the long internal perimeter road and large yard easily hold 3+ trucks between road and docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Entrance is a divided road split around a center median (separate in and out lanes at the same property-line point); counted as entry/exit separate with 1 lane each.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank runs along the SW/west wall of the building; counted roughly 30-35 doors with multiple trailers backed in (z19 west-dock imagery). Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large drop yard NW of the building full of parked trailers in long diagonal rows; ~70 trailers visible across the yard, capacity ~110. Banded 50+ for parked drop trailers.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage drop yard NW of the building, distinct from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Honest overhead estimate (~70) across the drop yard and dock face; counts vary by imagery date.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~23 acres derived from the traced perimeter (building footprint + drop yard + parking + perimeter drive); compact single-building cold-storage site.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail line runs past the area but does not serve the facility.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park in Plainville CT bordered by woods/wetland to the E and S; judged Rural per the small-town tie-breaker.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale resolved in the imagery; flagged uncertain (could exist on the private drive not covered by Street View).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single Americold building; the gray-roof building and office north of Northwest Drive are separate properties, not part of this campus.
